import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        boolean atUsed = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
                continue;
            }

            char c = s.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case 'd':
                    if (i + 2 < s.length() &&
                        s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't' &&
                        i + 2 != s.length() - 1) {
                        System.out.print('.');
                        i += 2;
                        break;
                    }
                    System.out.print(c);
                    break;

                case 'a':
                    if (!atUsed &&
                        i + 1 < s.length() &&
                        s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' &&
                        i + 1 != s.length() - 1) {
                        System.out.print('@');
                        atUsed = true;
                        i++;
                        break;
                    }
                    System.out.print(c);
                    break;

                default:
                    System.out.print(c);
                    break;
            }
        }
        scanner.close();
    }
}
